selected_work: VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_SET_05:F18 R111 MANAGED Texture2D mirror descriptor and SRV view exactness.
summary: R111 strengthens the R108-R110 managed mirror readiness chain with live D3D11 Texture2D/SRV descriptor and view-identity verification. A mirror is no longer readiness-valid solely because R103 created it: the concrete resource must still match source dimensions, one-mip/one-slice/single-sample shape, translated DXGI format, DEFAULT usage, exact SRV bind flags, zero CPU access/misc flags, Texture2D SRV mip window, expected D3D11 device and the SRV backing Texture2D identity.

risk_review.reason: Protected R50/R51 D3D9 renderer and startup regression paths were reviewed. R111 changes only dormant DX11 native backend readiness/probe/verifier code and does not modify D3D9 CreateDevice/Reset/Present, DirectGPU transport, HUD ownership, selector flow or vr-d3d9ex-focus. Runtime/HMD correctness is not inferred from hosted CI.

backend_conversion_gate.evidence: Queue/baseline/one-click/disassembly/native-transport/source-graph/census checks PASS; Win32 production build PASS; semantic/input-layout/input-signature smoke PASS; object/shader/linkage probes PASS; R111 hosted constant-buffer probe build and run PASS; binary verification and artifact upload PASS. openxr_vr_architecture.evidence: All six jobs PASS: host-x64, game-x86, game-x86-safe-draw-compare, game-x86-r26-hud-safe, game-x86-c1-r29-r28-classify, game-x86-c2-r30-hud.

evidence: Every R111 source-series commit contains the exact controller marker [AUTO:CONVERSION-DX11-00078] and no CI-skip directive; the final validation-bearing tree is bb04b87c1700d68fe9cf92263c5c2799e71a7cca.

NativeManagedTextureShadow::mirror_descriptor_exact re-queries the concrete D3D11 Texture2D and SRV and fails closed on expected-device, descriptor, SRV dimension/mip or backing-resource identity mismatch.
NativeManagedTextureMirrorReadiness adds descriptorExact and NativeManagedTextureStageReadiness adds descriptorExactMask; ready requires descriptor exactness.
R110 snapshot validation recomputes R111-strengthened stage readiness, so a descriptor-inexact resource cannot retain a valid ready snapshot.
No N100 clone/worktree, PC fast runner, Quest3/VDXR or in-game execution was used.
resume_cursor: R111 is automation-validated but runtime-untested. Managed mirror readiness now proves registry identity, lifetime freshness, concrete descriptor/view exactness and stale-snapshot rejection without exposing an SRV.
next_action: Continue F18 with one separate bounded activation prerequisite only if it remains non-routing, or move to the next incomplete DX11 exactness gate. Any raw SRV access, PSSetShaderResources/native draw integration or runtime promotion must be isolated and exact-build Quest3/VDXR gated.
